---
applyTo: "app/src/components/**,app/src/App.tsx,app/src/i18n/**"
---
- All text through `tr('English')`; add zh/ko/ja in `src/i18n/dict-*.ts` (keep `{placeholders}` identical).
- Status is never colour alone: pair a glyph and text.
- Add or update Playwright coverage in `app/e2e` for new tabs and flows.
- Read customer values from `activeCustomer()`.
